hypothesis: Bounded resolution on low-occurrence variables may derive missing complete XOR CNF sign-mask blocks, even when original source and binary SCC equivalence fail.
validity_requirements: All input literals range-validated; original byte SHA256 + DIMACS shape pinned before source-only processing
Derived clauses are ONLY exact non-tautological binary resolution resolvents of two previously validated source or proof-DAG clauses
Every derived clause includes parent IDs and resolved pivot; a separate checker rebuilds the resolvent exactly from original clauses
Any reported parity is a complete 2^(k-1) source+derived sign-mask block, k<=4, with at least one derived clause
New parity compared to ALL explicit original source XOR parity keys; no SAT/UNSAT claim and original clauses NEVER removed
On budget and process limit, report ABSTAIN or bounded partial scope, not exhaustion of all possible resolution
Adversarial forged proof chains, altered pivot, tautologies, and random finite truth-table entailment tests required
Frozen selection rule and budgets cannot be retuned after seeing public case results
interpretation: A zero result does not exclude hidden XOR under deeper resolution or alternative encodings; any positive is classical logical consequence, not speedup or an independently verified UNSAT certificate.
